partnershipPlan: Two carers from the carers' group review the information sheet and the consultee process; a night nurse and a day nurse join the monthly study meeting; the geriatricians review the escalation findings.
socialListening: No social media listening; the ward's compliments and complaints log from the last year is read for mentions of confusion or being woken.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I knew something was wrong with Dad on the second evening, but nobody asked me.
items.implication: Record whether a family concern preceded a positive screen.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At three in the morning I will not wake an old lady to ask her the months backwards.
items.implication: Measure how often night screens wake patients and report it as a balancing measure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I flag it, it sits in the notes, and the doctor sees it the next afternoon.
items.implication: Follow every positive screen to medical review.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: They keep asking me what year it is, as if I am daft.
items.implication: Note patient reactions on observed shifts; they may explain skipped screens.

summary: Four composite voices on family knowledge, night screening, escalation and the patient's view.
